answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run a burn registry: each participant permanently burns tokens to activate exactly one identity, recorded at a unique vertex of a public dependency graph, so no wallet spawns extra agents without paying again. The dashboard may look refined — an ivory panel with a velvet ribbon marking confirmed burns — but the logic is brutal: an attacker wanting a thousand fake agents at 500 tokens each destroys 500,000 tokens forever, about 5,000 USD, while fakes earn zero weight. Sybil resistance is money you never get back.
